THE UNITED REPUBLIC OF TANZANIA
NO. 8 OF 2020
I ASSENT
JOHN POMBE JOSEPH MAGUFULI
President
[15th June, 2020]
An Act to impose and alter certain taxes, duties, levies, fees and to amend
certain written laws relating to the collection and management of
public revenues.
ENACTED by Parliament of the United Republic.
PART I
PRELIMINARY PROVISIONS
Short title 1. This Act may be cited as the Finance Act, 2020.
Commence 2. This Act shall come into operation on the 1st day of
ment July, 2020.
